title: Mixing: One More Kiss by Wings | 1972
content:
Control Room Four, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

Wings’ song ‘One More Kiss’ was mixed in stereo on 12 December 1972.

This was the second of three consecutive mixing days for the Red Rose Speedway album, which also saw work done on ‘The Mess’ and ‘Mama’s Little Girl’. Only one of the songs made it onto the album.

Four stereo mixes of ‘One More Kiss’ were made, with the second marked as best. It became the fourth song on Red Rose Speedway.
